classification.difficultyReason: Read the correspondence from the circle, square and triangle markers. Then set up x appearing in both triangles (4/x = x/9) and solve x^2 = 36. This has the same demand as the trapezia task p34-q5, with the markers supplying the matching.

answer.worked:
Match the sides using the vertex symbols.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{4}&=\frac{9}{x}\\x^2&=4\times9\\x^2&=36\\x&=6\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
Take the positive value because $x$ is a length.
